overview:
THIS TRIP

11 days in Kumano Kodo, Japan, built around scenic viewpoints, history and culture and easy nature walks.

WHERE YOU SLEEP
1
Nachisan
10
nights

One base, Nachisan: also sleeping in Hongu would save about 25 minutes of travel a day over 7 days and reach 2 more places, but the move would cost about 2 h of packing up, checking in and travelling.

SIGNATURE EXPERIENCES

The trip is built around
I · DAY 5
Yunomine Onsen
Japan's oldest hot spring village, a relaxing soak after a day of walking, family-friendly public baths.
II · DAY 8
Adventure World
A large wildlife park with pandas and safari rides, a crowd-pleasing full-family day away from the trail.
III · DAY 10
Shirahama Beach
Popular white sand beach near Tanabe, good for a relaxed stop with kids before or after the trail.

THIS TRIP

11 days in Kumano Kodo, Japan, built around history and culture, easy nature walks and scenic viewpoints.

WHERE YOU SLEEP
1
Nachisan
10
nights

One base, Nachisan: also sleeping in Yunomine Onsen would save about 40 minutes of travel a day over 7 days and reach 1 more place, but the move would cost about 2 h 05 of packing up, checking in and travelling.

SIGNATURE EXPERIENCES

The trip is built around
I · DAY 2
Hosshinmon-oji to Hongu Taisha
The classic, gentlest stretch of the Nakahechi route, well within a family's walking range.

Scenic gorge boat ride through one of Japan's deepest ravines, a memorable detour from Hongu or Shingu.
III · DAY 9
Kumano Hongu Yunomine to Dainichi-goe pass
A short mountain pass walk connecting Yunomine and Hongu, a nice alternative to the road for able walkers.
